title: Rosmarinic Acid Inhibits beta-Sheet and beta-Hairpin Formation in Human Islet Amyloid Polypeptide Dimers by Stabilizing Localized C-Terminal Motifs: An REMD Study.
authors: Wang, Gang; Zhu, Xinyi; Zhao, Ziqian; Wu, Xiaoxiao; Qian, Zhenyu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过副本交换分子动力学模拟研究迷迭香酸抑制人胰岛淀粉样多肽二聚体β-折叠/β-发夹形成的机制，属于蛋白质构象采样与淀粉样聚集抑制的结构计算研究，与本课题高度相关。
abstract: The misfolding of human islet amyloid polypeptide (hIAPP) into soluble oligomers is a primary pathological event in type 2 diabetes, with the early dimerization process representing a critical pharmacological target. Here, we investigate the molecular mechanism by which rosmarinic acid (RA) counteracts full-length hIAPP self-association through replica-exchange molecular dynamics. Our results show that RA drastically suppresses overall beta-sheet propensities and truncates extended, aggregation-competent beta-strands, lowering the sampled population of ordered beta-hairpin-like motifs associated with amyloidogenic hIAPP conformations. Instead of forming compact structures, the hIAPP dimer is diverted toward disordered, hyper-solvated topologies. This conformational remodeling is driven by spatially heterogeneous thermodynamic perturbations that disrupt native interpeptide contacts and transfer structured motifs into localized turn and bend structures at the C-terminus. Energetically, RA outcompetes peptide-peptide interactions via a multimodal strategy, preferentially anchoring to the hIAPP N-terminus through residues K1 and R11 while simultaneously engaging the hydrophobic core via pi-pi stacking. Notably, this robust noncovalent occupation of key amyloidogenic regions occurs spontaneously in the simulations, offering an atomistic clue for modulating early hIAPP self-association. These structural and energetic insights clarify how RA interacts with transient hIAPP dimer ensembles, providing a defined biophysical framework for the rational design of amyloid inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 人胰岛淀粉样多肽（hIAPP）错误折叠为可溶性寡聚体是2型糖尿病的主要病理事件，其中早期二聚化过程代表了一个关键的药理学靶点。在此，我们通过副本交换分子动力学（replica-exchange molecular dynamics）研究了迷迭香酸（rosmarinic acid, RA）对抗全长hIAPP自缔合的分子机制。我们的结果表明，RA显著抑制整体β-折叠倾向，并截短延伸的、具有聚集能力的β-链，从而降低与淀粉样变性hIAPP构象相关的有序β-发夹样基序的采样群体。hIAPP二聚体并未形成紧凑结构，而是被导向无序、过度溶剂化的拓扑结构。这种构象重塑由空间异质的热力学扰动驱动，这些扰动破坏天然肽间接触，并将结构化基序转移至C末端的局部转角及弯曲结构。在能量上，RA通过多模式策略胜过肽-肽相互作用，优先通过残基K1和R11锚定于hIAPP N末端，同时通过π-π堆积与疏水核心结合。值得注意的是，这种对关键淀粉样变性区域稳健的非共价占据在模拟中自发发生，为调节早期hIAPP自缔合提供了原子层面的线索。这些结构与能量学见解阐明了RA如何与瞬态hIAPP二聚体集合相互作用，为淀粉样抑制剂合理设计提供了明确的生物物理框架。
